scorecard.rationale: Three oral ground Cinnamomum verum experiments from one research program report improved rotarod, open-field movement, and shorter timed pole turning/descent in aged A53T (PMID32889602, n=5-6/group; 2025 correction replaced separate benzoate histology panels) and MPTP mouse Parkinson models (PMID24946862, PMID31119595). No human clinical gait-speed trial isolates ground cinnamon (Park 2026 OA15.04 reports intake behavior only). Same-program mouse agility proxies without clinical gait data sustain only a minimal_signal against worsening. Isolated cinnamaldehyde improved vertical climbing in male Tau-expressing flies but did not show a clear difference in wild-type flies. This Alzheimer-related insect outcome supplies biological context without an additional Parkinson walking-speed effect after ground cinnamon.
